```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

nb <- read_rds("data/processed/neighborhoods.rds") |> st_transform(4326)
summary <- read_rds("data/processed/scenario_summary.rds")
last_bus <- read_rds("data/processed/last_bus_from_campus.rds")
dates <- read_rds("data/processed/analysis_dates.rds")
pretty_date <- function(d) format(as.Date(d), "%A, %B %d, %Y")

# Turn seconds after midnight into a clock time, like "8:31 pm"
clock <- function(seconds) {
  s <- as.numeric(seconds)
  h <- s %/% 3600
  m <- (s %% 3600) %/% 60
  sprintf("%d:%02d %s", ifelse(h %% 12 == 0, 12, h %% 12), m,
          ifelse(h >= 12, "pm", "am"))
}

# Look up summary numbers by scenario name, not row position,
# so they stay right if the table order ever changes
grocery_30 <- summary |>
  filter(str_detect(scenario, "Supermarket")) |>
  pull(pct_car_free_30min)
```

## At night

BC Transit's last bus out of campus on weekdays leaves at **`r clock(last_bus)`**. After that, only OCCT runs: to the **West Side and Downtown until 11:45 pm**, but to the **Southside and Johnson City's Main Street only until 9:35 pm**. Sunday through Thursday, nothing runs after midnight ([OCCT Fall 2026 schedule](https://occtransport.org/routeschedule.html)).

## The map

*Based on BC Transit's schedule for `r pretty_date(dates$weekday)` and `r pretty_date(dates$saturday)`.*

Pick a view in the box on the map. Each neighborhood is colored by the fastest trip by bus, including the walk to the stop. On Saturdays, about **`r round(100 * grocery_30)`%** of Broome County's car-free households can reach a supermarket within 30 minutes, by bus or on foot.

::: callout-warning
**OCCT isn't on this map.** It shows BC Transit only, since OCCT's schedules aren't in BC Transit's data. Students living near OCCT routes have more options than shown, especially on the West Side.
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
# One shared color scale for every view, so the same color means the
# same number of minutes everywhere
all_min <- c(nb$grocery_min, nb$campus_8am_min,
             nb$campus_sat_min, nb$campus_10pm_min)
pal <- colorNumeric("viridis", domain = c(0, max(all_min, na.rm = TRUE)),
                    reverse = TRUE, na.color = "transparent")

# Add one view to the map. Neighborhoods with access are filled by
# minutes; no-access neighborhoods get a dark dashed outline, no fill.
add_view <- function(map, minutes, group, what, none_text) {
  has <- !is.na(minutes)

  if (any(has)) {
    map <- map |>
      addPolygons(data = nb[has, ],
                  fillColor = pal(minutes[has]),
                  fillOpacity = 0.7,
                  color = "gray30",
                  weight = 0.5,
                  group = group,
                  label = paste0(round(minutes[has]), " min ", what))
  }

  if (any(!has)) {
    map <- map |>
      addPolygons(data = nb[!has, ],
                  fillColor = "white",
                  fillOpacity = 0.01,
                  color = "#222222",
                  weight = 1.5,
                  dashArray = "4 4",
                  group = group,
                  label = none_text)
  }

  map
}

views <- c("Groceries (Saturday)",
           "To campus: weekday, by 8am",
           "To campus: Saturday, by noon",
           "Leaving campus: weeknight, 10pm")

leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  add_view(nb$grocery_min, views[1], "to a supermarket",
           "No bus or walk to a supermarket") |>
  add_view(nb$campus_8am_min, views[2], "to campus",
           "No bus to campus by 8am") |>
  add_view(nb$campus_sat_min, views[3], "to campus",
           "No bus to campus by noon") |>
  add_view(nb$campus_10pm_min, views[4], "home from campus",
           "No BC Transit bus home after 10pm") |>
  addLayersControl(baseGroups = views,
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) |>
  addLegend(pal = pal,
            values = all_min,
            title = "Minutes, incl.<br>walk to stop",
            na.label = "No access (dashed outline)")
```
